doc.title: ADR 0001 — Approval has no amount limit yet
doc.quote: An invoice is approved by one person holding the billing admin scope, whatever its amount. The team has not decided whether an invoice above a limit needs a second approver; until it does, the code approves on one person's word and records who that was.
